title: A loopback webhook receiver posts each Alertmanager alert as a coord ask to the operator, so a firing alert reaches kbmon's needs-you line
goal: kbask.py webhook listens on loopback only and reads an Alertmanager version 4 webhook post, and for each firing alert posts one coord ask to operator naming the alert name, the item and the sprint from its labels (redacted, no label value beyond those), and posts nothing for a resolved alert or a body that is not an Alertmanager post; otel/alertmanager.yml's webhook points at it

run:
import subprocess, sys, os, json, socket, tempfile, time, urllib.request
R = os.getcwd(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
s = socket.socket(); s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0)); port = s.getsockname()[1]; s.close()
p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/kbask.py', '--store', S, 'webhook', '--port', str(port)], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
time.sleep(2)
labels = {'alertname': 'KbmonGateWaiting', 'item': 'ST-ab12cd34', 'sprint': 'SP-ef56gh78', 'instance': 'LEAK-label-value'}
body = json.dumps({'version': '4', 'status': 'firing', 'alerts': [{'status': 'firing', 'labels': labels, 'annotations': {}}]}).encode()
code = 0
try:
    urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:%d/alert' % port, body, {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}), timeout=10)
except Exception as e:
    code = str(e)
p.terminate()
ev = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, 'wait', '--since', '0', '--timeout', '0', '--kind', 'ask'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
text = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, 'list', '--prefix', 'ask/'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
print('post', code, ev[:200], text[:300])
sys.exit(0 if code == 0 and 'operator' in ev and all(x in text for x in ('KbmonGateWaiting', 'ST-ab12cd34', 'SP-ef56gh78')) and 'LEAK' not in text else 1)
